meta.description: Calculates molecular fingerprints and physicochemical descriptors with explicit choice tables, bit versus count semantics, MAP4 installation boundaries, and partial-charge model selection.

scientific_integrity.detail: The repaired QED and Gasteiger boundaries match reproduced behavior.

practice_boundaries.detail: Triage and charge methods are explicitly domain limited.

methodological_ground.detail: The repaired 3D protocol completed on flexible drug-like molecules.

code_usability.detail: The bundled example and audit checks ran with RDKit 2026.03.6.

functional_suitability.note: 2D, 3D, rule-set, and charge coverage has explicit selection guidance.

reliability.note: Seeds, convergence policy, and element guards address the prior defects.

performance_context.note: Baseline representations are bounded and library-scale validated.

agent_usability.note: Choice tables and boundaries make execution decisions explicit.

human_usability.note: Defaults, caveats, and recovery actions are direct.

security.note: No unsafe execution or credential behavior exists.

maintainability.note: The bundled helper and documentation use one 3D policy.

agent_specific.note: The description and dependency boundaries are discriminating.

inputs.note: Nine descriptor calls completed with no NaN or inf.

Unavailable or incompatible third-party packages are explicit reproducibility boundaries.
The Gasteiger section makes hydrogen convention and element scope executable.
The real-data 2D baseline remains fast and finite over 3224 ChEMBL hERG compounds.
